reason: It looks nice, but I need my phone near me anyway for emergencies and the kids, so the whole point of NOCTIS doesn't apply to me. I'd end up with the phone and a EUR 120 object on the same table.
objection: The phone is staying on my bedside table regardless, so I'd be paying EUR 120 for a second alarm clock that tells me things my phone already does.
would_change_my_mind: If it let urgent calls from a short list of people (family, school) come through, so I could really leave the phone in another room, and it was around EUR 80.
